grades.reason: Describes RISC-V H-extension virtualization and privilege modes. It says nothing about executing a privileged instruction from user mode or the resulting exception.
Covers MXR and SUM memory-access privilege bits in sstatus. It does not cover privileged instruction execution from user mode.
Covers privilege-mode filtering of the cycle and instret counters (Smcntrpmf). It is unrelated to user-mode attempts to execute privileged instructions.

grades.quote: All privileged instructions are accessible only at the PLV0 privilege level. The only exception is that when the `RPERF1` / `RPERF2` / `RPERF3` in `CSR.MISC` is configured to `1` , the `CSRRD` instruction can be executed at PLV1/PLV2/PLV3 privilege level to read the performance counter.
grades.reason: States the execution rule: privileged instructions are accessible only at PLV0, so user-level privilege (PLV3) cannot run them. It also gives the CSRRD performance-counter exception to that rule. It does not describe the exception raised on a violation.
